site.name: Hallie A Mine
overview: Hallie A Mine is a documented historic tungsten mine in western Boulder County, preserved in state and federal mining records and mapped on the Ward quadrangle.

timeline.text: Colorado mining reporting and federal mineral-exploration records documented the Hallie A tungsten property in Boulder County.

moreHistory: Federal place mapping preserves the Hallie A mine locality at approximately 40.019431, -105.511665. This identifies the historic mine area without claiming that a surviving shaft or portal has been field-surveyed.

sourceReferences.title: USGS Data Series 1004 — Historical Files from Federal Government Mineral Exploration-Assistance Programs, 1950 to 1974
